panels.title: Data through
panels.description:
Last day included in this load (the nightly window ends at 23:59 UTC that day).

**Source:** n360.runs, written by load.py only after every data check passes  
**Filter:** loaded runs only; the latest  
**Window:** the latest load

targets.rawSql:
SELECT formatDateTime(window_end, '%e %b %Y') AS data_through
        FROM n360.runs WHERE status = 'loaded' ORDER BY loaded_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Lines above billed
panels.description:
Contract lines whose measured count is over the billed amount. The measure follows the contract: a contract rule where one is mapped, otherwise the platform engaged flag (billable unit unconfirmed). Pooled lines are counted once, as their pool.

**Source:** n360.v_line_status  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** each line from its start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(pct_billed > 100) AS above FROM n360.v_line_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Contract lines
panels.description:
One row per contract line. Used = the contract measure. An empty cell means the line was not read or is not measurable, never zero.

**Source:** the platform daily conversation aggregate table and the conversation records reader; contract terms from the entitlement sheet unless a signed SOW overrides it (Contract unit). Via n360.v_line_status and n360.account  
**Filter:** Customer; lines not in a pool (pooled lines are in the table below)  
**Window:** Used: from the start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.display_name AS Customer, l.channel AS Channel, l.measure AS Measure,
               l.consumed AS Used, l.billed AS Billed, l.pct_billed AS `% of billed`,
               l.pct_term_elapsed AS `% of term`, l.start_date AS Start, l.end_date AS End, l.unit AS `Contract unit`
        FROM n360.v_line_status AS l INNER JOIN n360.account AS a ON a.account = l.account
        WHERE l.pool_id IS NULL AND l.account IN (${account:singlequote})
        ORDER BY Customer, Channel

panels.title: Pooled entitlements
panels.description:
One entitlement shared by several lines of one account. Lines in a pool are never compared with the billed amount one by one.

**Source:** consumption_mapping.json "pools", via n360.v_pool_status  
**Filter:** Customer  
**Window:** Used: the pooled lines, each from its start date to the data-through day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT name AS Pool, billed AS Billed, consumed AS Used, pct_billed AS `% of billed`, start_date AS Start, end_date AS End
        FROM n360.v_pool_status WHERE account IN (${account:singlequote})

panels.title: Daily use per contract line
panels.description:
Daily contract measure per line (conversations for rules that bill every conversation, billable for meaningful-engagement rules, engaged otherwise). Days not read show as gaps, not zero.

**Source:** n360.line_day with n360.contract_line  
**Filter:** Customer; contract lines only  
**Window:** dashboard time range, per day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(d.day) AS time, concat(l.account, ' · ', l.channel) AS line, d.measured AS used
        FROM n360.line_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.contract_line AS l ON l.series_key = d.series_key
        WHERE d.kind = 'line' AND d.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND $__dateFilter(d.day)
        ORDER BY time

panels.title: Containment per VA (weekly)
panels.description:
containment = 1 - handoffs / engaged conversations, per VA and week. One line per VA, so channels are never combined. VAs whose handoffs are not read (conversation records reader) are not shown, rather than shown as zero.

**Source:** the platform daily conversation aggregate table (n360.va_day, n360.va)  
**Filter:** Customer; VAs with handoff data; weeks with engaged conversations  
**Window:** dashboard time range, by week (Monday start)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT toDateTime(toMonday(d.day)) AS time, concat(v.va_name, ' (', arrayStringConcat(v.channels, ', '), ')') AS va,
               1 - sum(d.handoffs) / sum(d.engaged) AS containment
        FROM n360.va_day AS d INNER JOIN n360.va AS v ON v.bot_id = d.bot_id
        WHERE d.account IN (${account:singlequote}) AND d.handoffs IS NOT NULL AND $__dateFilter(d.day)
        GROUP BY time, va HAVING sum(d.engaged) > 0 ORDER BY time
